indicator_definition: This indicator measures the proportion of households with broadband internet access, expressed as a percentage of all households. Broadband includes fixed (DSL, cable, fibre) and mobile broadband connections. Data are collected through the EU Survey on ICT Usage in Households and by Individuals.
rationale: Broadband access is essential for participation in the digital economy, access to public services and social inclusion. Expanding access, particularly in rural areas, is key to reducing the digital divide. Progress means an increasing proportion of households connected to broadband.
methodology_characteristics: Data are collected through the EU ICT Survey, conducted annually. The indicator covers fixed and mobile broadband connections with download speeds of at least 144 Kbps. Data are published annually by Eurostat.
